name: Wall Climb
design_intent:
N2 circuit (hard navigation, owner 2026-07-16) course 1/5: BOOST UP TWO TALL VERTICAL WALLS. Two 2200px bumper chimneys in sequence with a traverse between; bumper walls give NO fuel refunds, so the tiny trampoline ledges bolted inside each shaft are the fuel route.

MOVEMENT MATH (current Tuning): tank 100 = 3.5s thrust at 28.6 fuel/s; boost cap 760 px/s => ~26.6px of powered flight per fuel, one full tank ~2660px. Trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; zero-boost drift reach ~395px (trampoline). Each pad TOUCH refunds +20 fuel.

FLIGHT-REQUIRED PROOF: every ledge-to-ledge climb segment is 730-740px vertical -- 2.7x the trampoline apex (270) and 1.5x even a spring apex (480), so NO bounce reaches the next ledge; only sustained boost does. Horizontal entries: start pad (ends x=320) to chimney-1 mouth (x=760) = 440px > 395px trampoline drift; traverse (ends x=2100) to chimney-2 mouth (x=2500) = 400px at matching height but the 300px mouth (y 200..500) demands aimed flight, and the exit crest over each 2200px wall is pure boost.

FUEL BUDGET (the actual test): chimney = base pad 2400 -> L1 1670 -> L2 940 -> crest 200: segments 730/730/740px cost ~27/27/31 fuel; each ledge touch refunds +20, so net drain ~7-11 per segment; multi-bouncing base/traverse pads tops the tank to 100. Sustainable ledger, never below ~40 on the intended line. EXPERT ALT LINE: a one-tank exterior wall-scale (2200px = ~83 fuel + exit drift ~8) arrives at the traverse with <10 fuel -- legal but knife-edge; the interior ledge route is the taught line (hence the hint: walls refund NOTHING).

GEOMETRY: chimney 1 walls x 760-880 (left, y 200..2100, 300px entry mouth below it) and x 1280-1400 (right, full 200..2400); interior 400px wide vs 92px player. Base pad y=2400, ledges alternate sides (L1 right y=1670, L2 left y=940). Traverse pad y=500. Chimney 2 mirrors it 1900px higher: walls x 2500-2620 (mouth y 200..500) and x 3020-3140, base y=500, L3 y=-230, L4 y=-960, crest -1700, goal pad y=-1750. Falls drop past everything into the void line -> free respawn at start_gate (no penalty), so a blown climb costs time, not stock.

BOUNDS: explicit because the course spans y 2400..-1750. Top -3600 clears a vertical super from L4 (-960 - 2450 super apex = -3410) with 190px to spare and sits 1850px above the goal pad; bottom 3200 keeps the void (y 2600) as the killer; sides +/-700 past geometry.
